description:
## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
After review approval use coverage-upper per repository workflow with fresh report and targeted meaningful tests; review resulting changes and record justified exceptions. No numerical gate imposed on prior development tasks.
Owners/files: Changed-file tests/coverage and issue/PR evidence.

## Tests to add before implementation
Fresh mix coveralls.json then mix coverup through Context Mode and coverage skill; isolated meaningful tests and required checks for changes.
Preserve existing expectations unless explicitly approved; property-test invariants where applicable.

## Branches/paths validated
Cover success, denied/nil actor, absent configuration/resource, stale/concurrent state, invalid input and side-effect failure as relevant to the operation above. Record concrete assertions before coding. Honor the agreed terminal provider-failure versus infrastructure-recovery distinction.

## Mocking plan
Mock only external provider HTTP/conversion/embedding edges where applicable; keep Repo/Sandbox, Oban, NodeRouter, Jido validation and ZAQ domains real. Resolve runtime dependencies through Zaq.Config.get/4 and explicit opts/context. Deterministic barriers/clock/ID controls; no global Application environment mutation or cross-test PubSub leakage. Audit-only tasks need no mocks.

## Documentations to update for both code and docs/
Update changed module contracts and applicable owning Agent/Ingestion/System/architecture/BO guides; no duplicate standards. Tests/gate-only work records evidence in this issue. Read DESIGN.md/BO component guide for UI, relevant service guide before domain changes.

## Action reuse assessment
Not applicable: test/coverage work, no new production operation. Runtime seams use Zaq.Config.get/4 and explicit opts.
Before implementation recheck candidate @moduledoc, schemas, callers and tests, record concrete evidence and final public input/output/error/permission/retry contracts. Missing standalone Actions must be implemented in their prerequisite issue before callers. Nil identity never grants authority; cross-role BO operations use fixed Events and NodeRouter. No generic invoke endpoint.

## Scope, prerequisites and validation
Parent PR2 epic: zaq-kw0.42; reviewed source: https://chatgpt.com/space/page_fa28a6b2fe70819199a0a178f96c7fb6 .
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md and docs/action-reuse.md. Dependencies wired on creation; do not start before prerequisites complete.
Immediate scoped tests and mix q per issue; final mix precommit belongs to zaq-kw0.20 after review/coverage. Existing feature human UX gate zaq-kw0.15 -> consolidated E2E zaq-kw0.16 remains open in PR3; add scenarios now, author new feature E2E only after explicit approval. Existing required E2E execution remains applicable.
Planning only: no implementation, code commit/push/merge or approval granted by creating this issue.
